climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A state that shares the huge Upper Mississippi Valley AVA, the nation's largest, with Minnesota, Iowa and Illinois, and wholly contains two others, Lake Wisconsin and Wisconsin Ledge. A statewide winery association promotes winemaking.
